title: Every item owes an e2e proof: a chore, a bug and a feature are refused without one, whatever the description says, and accepted with one
description: POST /api/work refuses an item of every type whose criteria name no e2e: proof, whether or not the description opens 'No user-facing change:', naming the case binding; the same creates succeed once a criterion carries an e2e: proof.
